title: Capacity Supply Configuration
description: User-provided declaration of delivery capacity (supply) for demand-vs-supply load analysis. Declares supply only; dimension-to-work-item-field mapping lives in field-reference-mappings.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema file.

unit.description: Unit of the capacity amounts (e.g. personWeeks, FTE, storyPoints, budgetCurrency). Must share a unit family with the rolled-up demand field.

asOfDate.description: Provenance: date the supply figures were stated.

source.description: Provenance: origin of the supply figures (e.g. 'PMO capacity plan v3').

thresholds.description: Classification policy. Overridable by command options. Percentages.

capacity.description: Capacity supply records. Sparse by design.

areaPath.description: Area-path dimension key (native Azure DevOps field).

period.description: Discrete time bucket the capacity applies to (e.g. 2026-H1, 2026-Q3).

amount.description: Capacity amount in the file's unit.
